""name"": ""How many questions are on the AP CSA practice exams?"",

""text"": ""The two full AP CSA practice exams each contain 42 multiple-choice questions, matching the format of the real AP Computer Science A exam. Each question has 4 answer choices (A-D) and the exam is designed to be completed in 90 minutes, just like the actual Bluebook digital exam.""
""name"": ""Which AP CSA units should I practice most?"",

""text"": ""Unit 4 (Data Collections) carries the most weight at 30-40% of the exam, followed by Unit 2 (Selection and Iteration) at 25-35%. Together these two units represent 55-75% of the MCQ section. Start with the Unit 4 and Unit 2 practice exams before taking a full 42-question exam.""
""name"": ""Are these AP CSA practice exams aligned to the 2027 curriculum?"",

""text"": ""Yes. All practice exams on this page are built for the 2026-2027 AP CSA 4-unit curriculum. They do not include inheritance, polymorphism, extends, or super keywords, which were removed from the course. They do include File and Scanner class topics, which are new to the 2025-2026 curriculum.""
